system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a Helm chart for a stateful application requiring a database migration before pod startup: pre-install hook Job for migrations, StatefulSet for the app, headless Service, and PVC.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Create a Helm chart for a stateful application requiring a database migration before pod startup: pre-install hook Job for migrations, StatefulSet for the app, headless Service, and PVC.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
name: stateful-app
version: 1.0.0
description: A Helm chart for a stateful application
type: application
appVersion: 1.0.0
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: stateful-app
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
database:
  name: stateful-app
  user: stateful-app
  password: stateful-app
  host: localhost
  port: 5432
migration:
  image:
    repository: stateful-app-migration
    tag: latest
  command: ["migrate"]
volume:
  size: 1Gi
  storageClass: standard
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "stateful-app.fullname" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_NAME
          value: {{ .Values.database.name }}
        - name: DATABASE_USER
          value: {{ .Values.database.user }}
        - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
          value: {{ .Values.database.password }}
        - name: DATABASE_HOST
          value: {{ .Values.database.host }}
        - name: DATABASE_PORT
          value: {{ .Values.database.port | quote }}
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
spec:
  selector:
    app: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    targetPort: http
  clusterIP: None
  type: ClusterIP
---
# FILE: templates/pvc.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.volume.size }}
  storageClassName: {{ .Values.volume.storageClass }}
---
# FILE: templates/pre-install-migration.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}-migration
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-install
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": hook-failed
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: migration
        image: "{{ .Values.migration.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.migration.image.tag }}"
        command: {{ .Values.migration.command }}
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
  backoffLimit: 4
---
# FILE: templates/pre-upgrade-migration.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "stateful-app.fullname" . }}-migration
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade
    "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": hook-failed
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: migration
        image: "{{ .Values.migration.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.migration.image.tag }}"
        command: {{ .Values.migration.command }}
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
  backoffLimit: 4
